scope: Verify allocation-failure behavior while admitting owned generated NOD dictionary source metadata.

behavior: The test installs a valid owned NOD snapshot, then injects std::bad_alloc into DxfDictionaryEntryAdmission while validating a replacement root entry.
The setter returns false, consumes the moved candidate, and preserves the previously accepted source handle and entry payload.
A fresh candidate with the same replacement payload is accepted on the same codec after the fault is removed.
This is setup-state safety evidence only; it adds no DWG/DXF fixture and no format support claim.

limitations: The fault is injected at the first root dictionary admission allocation; this does not sweep later allocations or the optional GROUP/IMAGE dictionary admission maps.
Output assembly allocations and native CAD semantics remain unqualified.
next: Continue allocation-failure coverage across independent source dictionary and OBJECTS builders; retain source lifetime, platform numeric/string policy, and scoped concurrency in the safety audit.
